title: Entrepreneurship: A Global Perspective

exam.type: Midterm essay, closed book: four questions of 25 marks, the last a choice of two topics

shelf_blurb: Sessions 1–5 and 7 of Entrepreneurship: A Global Perspective, from definitions of international entrepreneurship, small firms and GEM country comparisons to regions, internationalization theories and migrant entrepreneurs, with 229 flashcards, a 66-question quiz, a mock exam and worked answers to the lecturer's mock midterm.
